title: Chat: Add WhatsApp and Instagram as channels in the shared inbox
description: Intercom routes chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and SMS into one inbox (https://www.intercom.com/helpdesk) and Crisp includes WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, Line and Viber from its $95/month Essentials plan (https://crisp.chat/en/pricing/). Chat only has the web widget (app/api/chat/widget.js); conversations, visitors and rules in lib/chat-data.ts assume a widget. For teams in LatAm WhatsApp is the main support channel, so this is the first thing they ask after switching. First scope: a WhatsApp Business Cloud connection per workspace (webhook in, Graph API out) that creates chat_conversations with a channel column, shows a channel icon in the inbox rows, sends agent replies back respecting the 24 h window, and reuses assignment rules, SLA, tags and the AI bot. Instagram DMs as a second step over the same channel abstraction.

title: Chat: Send proactive messages by page URL, time on page or returning visitor
description: Intercom includes proactive chats, banners and tooltips on every plan (https://www.intercom.com/pricing) and Crisp has chat triggers from the Mini plan (https://crisp.chat/en/pricing/). Our widget only opens when the visitor clicks the launcher; the widget already knows the page URL and referrer (lib/chat-visitor-context.ts) but no rule uses them. A pricing-page nudge is how small teams turn chat into sales. First scope: per-widget auto messages with conditions (URL contains, seconds on page, first or returning visit, office hours only), a message body and optional sender, shown as an unread bubble without creating a conversation until the visitor answers, with a per-visitor frequency cap and sent/replied counts.

title: Chat: Notify agents on their phone with an installable PWA and Web Push
description: Intercom and Crisp ship iOS and Android teammate apps with push, and Crisp added Mac and Windows apps in 2026 (https://crisp.chat/en/blog/march-2026-product-update/). zerosoft has no service worker or Web Push, so an agent away from the desk never learns about a new chat until they reopen the tab; the inbox at 390px already works (tested). First scope: a web app manifest and service worker for /app, an opt-in for push in Chat settings, push on new conversation, on a visitor reply to a conversation assigned to me and on @mention, with a deep link to /app/chat/inbox/<id> and per-user quiet hours.

title: Chat: Add teams with their own inbox, round-robin and assignment rules
description: Intercom has team inboxes, round robin per team and skill-based routing (https://www.intercom.com/helpdesk, https://www.intercom.com/changes/en/page/1); Crisp has sub-inboxes from Essentials (https://crisp.chat/en/pricing/). Our assignment rules (app/api/chat/rules) and the conversation header only assign to a person, so a team of four cannot split Support and Sales or route billing questions to one group. First scope: chat teams (name, members), assign a conversation to a team and optionally a person, an inbox filter per team, rules that target a team with round-robin among its available members, and team in reports and webhooks.

title: Chat: Show who is viewing or replying to a conversation to avoid double answers
description: Intercom shows when a teammate is viewing or typing in the same conversation; without it two agents answer the same customer. We already track typing for the visitor side (app/api/chat/conversations/[id]/typing) but agents never see each other. First scope: record agent presence per conversation on the existing 3 s poll, show avatars of other agents viewing and an 'Ana is replying' line above the composer, and warn before sending if another agent replied in the last minute.

title: Chat: Fill variables like {{name}} and {{email}} in saved replies and macros
description: Intercom macros insert attributes such as first name and company. Our saved replies (components/chat/CannedClient.tsx) are inserted literally: a reply with {{name}} reached the visitor as '{{name}}' in the benchmark walk, and the keyword bot sends canned bodies as they are. First scope: support {{name}}, {{first_name}}, {{email}}, {{agent_name}} and custom conversation attributes with a fallback ({{name|there}}), a variable picker in the canned editor, substitution on insert in the composer and in the bot path, and a preview.

title: Chat: Create or link a Track issue from a conversation and reply to all when it ships
description: Intercom has back-office and tracker tickets: one ticket groups many conversations and a note can be posted to all of them at once (https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/6436600-tickets-explained, https://intercom.com/help/en/articles/8300306-how-to-manage-tracker-tickets). Track is in the same suite but a human agent cannot file a bug from the conversation (only the AI agent can, with track_create_issue). First scope: 'Create issue' and 'Link issue' in the conversation panel with the title prefilled from the last visitor message and a transcript link, a linked-conversations list on the issue, and when the issue moves to Done a one-click reply to every linked open conversation.

title: Chat: Report bot deflection, tags, busiest hours and SLA compliance
description: Intercom reports Fin and humans together with response times, ratings and SLA metrics, plus custom reports on higher plans (https://www.intercom.com/pricing). Our Reports page (getChatRangeReport in lib/chat-inbox.ts) shows conversations, first response, resolution and CSAT per agent; a conversation answered by the bot shows a dash in first response and there is no bot resolution rate. First scope: bot-resolved vs handed-off counts, conversations by tag and by widget, a weekday by hour heatmap of new conversations, and percent within SLA for first response and resolution, all with the same date range and CSV.

title: Chat: Save inbox filters as views in the sidebar
description: Intercom turned saved searches into sidebar Views in October 2026 (https://www.intercom.com/changes/en/page/1). Our inbox (components/chat/InboxShell.tsx) has status, assignee, tag and text filters but they reset on each visit, so 'urgent + billing tag + unassigned' has to be rebuilt every time. First scope: save the current filter set with a name, list views under Inbox in the Chat sidebar with live counts, share a view with the team or keep it private, and reorder or delete views.

title: Chat: Find conversations and people from Cmd+K
description: Cmd+K (lib/app-search.ts) finds chat widgets but not conversations or visitors, so finding 'the customer from yesterday' means opening the inbox and switching the status filter. Intercom search covers conversations, people and messages. First scope: add chat visitors (name, email) and conversations (subject, last message, visitor) to the palette with status and age as meta, linking to /app/chat/inbox/<id> and /app/chat/people/<id>, scoped to the widgets the user can access.
